openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Search & Recommendations
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Mock-backed developer API. Marketplace wire contract and purchase
    source are not finalized. Unknown or repeated query parameters are rejected.
    Integer query parameters use decimal digits only; prices are pre-discount
    EUR minor units.
servers:
  - url: /
    description: Current application origin
paths:
  /api/v1/search:
    get:
      operationId: search
      summary: Search
      description: Find public products using text, filters, sorting, and pagination.
        Every query term must match. Visibility and filters apply before sorting
        and pagination. Active out-of-stock products are included by default.
      tags:
        - Search
      security: []
      parameters:
        - name: q
          in: query
          required: false
          description: "Trimmed; at most 200 characters and 20 terms. Empty allows
            browsing. Default: empty."
          schema:
            default: ""
            type: string
            maxLength: 200
        - name: category
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Exact category name, 1–128 characters.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 128
        - name: sellerId
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Exact seller identifier, 1–128 characters.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 128
        - name: availability
          in: query
          required: false
          description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - in_stock
              - out_of_stock
        - name: minPriceMinor
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Inclusive minimum, nonnegative safe integer in euro cents.
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 9007199254740991
        - name: maxPriceMinor
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Inclusive maximum; must be at least minPriceMinor.
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 9007199254740991
        - name: sort
          in: query
          required: false
          description: "relevance, price_asc, price_desc, or name_asc. Default: relevance."
          schema:
            default: relevance
            type: string
            enum:
              - relevance
              - price_asc
              - price_desc
              - name_asc
        - name: page
          in: query
          required: false
          description: "Positive safe integer. Pages beyond the end return empty items.
            Default: 1."
          schema:
            default: 1
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 9007199254740991
        - name: pageSize
          in: query
          required: false
          description: "1–100 items per page. Default: 20."
          schema:
            default: 20
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success (including empty results)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      items:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            offerId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            productId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            sellerId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            name:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                            category:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            imageUrls:
                              type: array
                              items:
                                type: string
                                format: uri
                            priceMinor:
                              type: integer
                              minimum: 0
                              maximum: 9007199254740991
                            currency:
                              type: string
                              const: EUR
                            availability:
                              type: string
                              enum:
                                - in_stock
                                - out_of_stock
                          required:
                            - offerId
                            - productId
                            - sellerId
                            - name
                            - category
                            - imageUrls
                            - priceMinor
                            - currency
                            - availability
                          additionalProperties: false
                      total:
                        type: integer
                        minimum: 0
                        maximum: 9007199254740991
                      page:
                        type: integer
                        exclusiveMinimum: 0
                        maximum: 9007199254740991
                      pageSize:
                        type: integer
                        minimum: 1
                        maximum: 100
                    required:
                      - items
                      - total
                      - page
                      - pageSize
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - data
                additionalProperties: false
              examples:
                success:
                  value:
                    data:
                      items:
                        - offerId: off_1
                          productId: prd_1
                          sellerId: sel_2
                          name: Wireless Mouse
                          category: Electronics
                          imageUrls: &a1 []
                          priceMinor: 1999
                          currency: EUR
                          availability: in_stock
                      total: 1
                      page: 1
                      pageSize: 20
                empty:
                  value:
                    data:
                      items: []
                      total: 0
                      page: 1
                      pageSize: 20
        "400":
          description: Invalid query
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "500":
          description: Unexpected error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "503":
          description: Dependency unavailable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
  /api/v1/search/facets:
    get:
      operationId: facets
      summary: Facets
      description: Get filter values, counts, and the available price range. Each
        facet ignores its own filter and respects the others. The price range
        ignores both price bounds. Counts represent products, not purchases.
      tags:
        - Search
      security: []
      parameters:
        - name: q
          in: query
          required: false
          description: "Trimmed; at most 200 characters and 20 terms. Empty allows
            browsing. Default: empty."
          schema:
            default: ""
            type: string
            maxLength: 200
        - name: category
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Exact category name, 1–128 characters.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 128
        - name: sellerId
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Exact seller identifier, 1–128 characters.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 128
        - name: availability
          in: query
          required: false
          description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - in_stock
              - out_of_stock
        - name: minPriceMinor
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Inclusive minimum, nonnegative safe integer in euro cents.
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 9007199254740991
        - name: maxPriceMinor
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Inclusive maximum; must be at least minPriceMinor.
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 9007199254740991
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success (including empty results)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      categories:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            category:
                              type: string
                            count:
                              type: integer
                              exclusiveMinimum: 0
                              maximum: 9007199254740991
                          required:
                            - category
                            - count
                          additionalProperties: false
                      sellers:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            sellerId:
                              type: string
                            count:
                              type: integer
                              exclusiveMinimum: 0
                              maximum: 9007199254740991
                          required:
                            - sellerId
                            - count
                          additionalProperties: false
                      availability:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            availability:
                              type: string
                              enum:
                                - in_stock
                                - out_of_stock
                            count:
                              type: integer
                              exclusiveMinimum: 0
                              maximum: 9007199254740991
                          required:
                            - availability
                            - count
                          additionalProperties: false
                      priceRange:
                        anyOf:
                          - type: object
                            properties:
                              minPriceMinor:
                                type: integer
                                minimum: 0
                                maximum: 9007199254740991
                              maxPriceMinor:
                                type: integer
                                minimum: 0
                                maximum: 9007199254740991
                            required:
                              - minPriceMinor
                              - maxPriceMinor
                            additionalProperties: false
                          - type: "null"
                    required:
                      - categories
                      - sellers
                      - availability
                      - priceRange
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - data
                additionalProperties: false
              examples:
                success:
                  value:
                    data:
                      categories:
                        - category: Electronics
                          count: 1
                      sellers:
                        - sellerId: sel_2
                          count: 1
                      availability:
                        - availability: in_stock
                          count: 1
                      priceRange:
                        minPriceMinor: 1999
                        maxPriceMinor: 1999
                empty:
                  value:
                    data:
                      categories: []
                      sellers: []
                      availability: []
                      priceRange: null
        "400":
          description: Invalid query
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "500":
          description: Unexpected error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "503":
          description: Dependency unavailable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
  /api/v1/search/autocomplete:
    get:
      operationId: autocomplete
      summary: Autocomplete
      description: Suggest visible product names as customers type. Matches the start
        of the full normalized name. Results are alphabetical with product ID as
        a tie-breaker; query history is not stored.
      tags:
        - Search
      security: []
      parameters:
        - name: q
          in: query
          required: true
          description: At least 2 characters; at most 200 characters and 20 terms.
            Normalized name prefix.
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 200
        - name: category
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Exact category name, 1–128 characters.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 128
        - name: availability
          in: query
          required: false
          description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - in_stock
              - out_of_stock
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          description: "1–10 suggestions. Default: 5."
          schema:
            default: 5
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 10
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success (including empty results)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      suggestions:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            productId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            name:
                              type: string
                          required:
                            - productId
                            - name
                          additionalProperties: false
                    required:
                      - suggestions
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - data
                additionalProperties: false
              examples:
                success:
                  value:
                    data:
                      suggestions:
                        - productId: prd_1
                          name: Wireless Mouse
                empty:
                  value:
                    data:
                      suggestions: []
        "400":
          description: Invalid query
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "500":
          description: Unexpected error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "503":
          description: Dependency unavailable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
  /api/v1/recommendations/similar:
    get:
      operationId: similar
      summary: Similar products
      description: Find alternatives in the source product's category. Same category
        only. Rank by shared attribute pairs, then absolute price difference,
        then product ID. Exclude the source. Missing or hidden sources return
        404.
      tags:
        - Recommendations
      security: []
      parameters:
        - name: productId
          in: query
          required: true
          description: Active source product identifier, 1–128 characters.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 128
        - name: availability
          in: query
          required: false
          description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - in_stock
              - out_of_stock
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          description: "1–20 items. Default: 5."
          schema:
            default: 5
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 20
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success (including empty results)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      items:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            offerId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            productId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            sellerId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            name:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                            category:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            imageUrls:
                              type: array
                              items:
                                type: string
                                format: uri
                            priceMinor:
                              type: integer
                              minimum: 0
                              maximum: 9007199254740991
                            currency:
                              type: string
                              const: EUR
                            availability:
                              type: string
                              enum:
                                - in_stock
                                - out_of_stock
                          required:
                            - offerId
                            - productId
                            - sellerId
                            - name
                            - category
                            - imageUrls
                            - priceMinor
                            - currency
                            - availability
                          additionalProperties: false
                    required:
                      - items
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - data
                additionalProperties: false
              examples:
                success:
                  value:
                    data:
                      items:
                        - offerId: off_5
                          productId: prd_5
                          sellerId: sel_3
                          name: Desk Speaker
                          category: Electronics
                          imageUrls: *a1
                          priceMinor: 2999
                          currency: EUR
                          availability: in_stock
                empty:
                  value:
                    data:
                      items: []
        "400":
          description: Invalid query
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "404":
          description: Product not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "500":
          description: Unexpected error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "503":
          description: Dependency unavailable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
  /api/v1/recommendations/also-bought:
    get:
      operationId: also_bought
      summary: Also bought
      description: Recommend products that occur together in synthetic purchase
        groups. Count each pair once per purchase, then sort by count descending
        and product ID. No history means no results. Similarity and popularity
        are never substituted. Purchase data is synthetic.
      tags:
        - Recommendations
      security: []
      parameters:
        - name: productId
          in: query
          required: true
          description: Active source product identifier, 1–128 characters.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 128
        - name: availability
          in: query
          required: false
          description: in_stock or out_of_stock. Omit to include both.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - in_stock
              - out_of_stock
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          description: "1–20 items. Default: 5."
          schema:
            default: 5
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 20
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success (including empty results)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      items:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            offerId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            productId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            sellerId:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            name:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                            category:
                              type: string
                              minLength: 1
                              maxLength: 128
                            imageUrls:
                              type: array
                              items:
                                type: string
                                format: uri
                            priceMinor:
                              type: integer
                              minimum: 0
                              maximum: 9007199254740991
                            currency:
                              type: string
                              const: EUR
                            availability:
                              type: string
                              enum:
                                - in_stock
                                - out_of_stock
                          required:
                            - offerId
                            - productId
                            - sellerId
                            - name
                            - category
                            - imageUrls
                            - priceMinor
                            - currency
                            - availability
                          additionalProperties: false
                    required:
                      - items
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - data
                additionalProperties: false
              examples:
                success:
                  value:
                    data:
                      items:
                        - offerId: off_2
                          productId: prd_2
                          sellerId: sel_3
                          name: Quiet Mouse
                          category: Electronics
                          imageUrls: *a1
                          priceMinor: 2999
                          currency: EUR
                          availability: out_of_stock
                empty:
                  value:
                    data:
                      items: []
        "400":
          description: Invalid query
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "404":
          description: Product not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "500":
          description: Unexpected error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
        "503":
          description: Dependency unavailable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - code
                      - message
                    additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  - error
                additionalProperties: false
components:
  schemas:
    DiscoveryItem:
      $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
      type: object
      properties:
        offerId:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        productId:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        sellerId:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
        category:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        imageUrls:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
            format: uri
        priceMinor:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 9007199254740991
        currency:
          type: string
          const: EUR
        availability:
          type: string
          enum:
            - in_stock
            - out_of_stock
      required:
        - offerId
        - productId
        - sellerId
        - name
        - category
        - imageUrls
        - priceMinor
        - currency
        - availability
      additionalProperties: false
    Error:
      $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
